name: 22920 · Afton, VA
findings: ZIP 22920 (Afton) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22920 (Afton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
